title: Fix CI build and test errors
body:
Main branch CI failing on both `Build Core` and `Test` jobs due to TypeScript errors and a missing mock export.

### Build errors

- **`DesignDrawer.tsx`** — Remove unused `useState` import (TS6133)
- **`DesignDrawer.test.tsx`, `DashboardViewSelection.test.tsx`** — `@radix-ui/react-dialog` is a transitive dep (lives in `@object-ui/components`), so `vi.importActual<typeof import('...')>` fails type resolution. Use untyped `importActual` with `Record<string, unknown>` cast instead.
- **`AgGridImpl.tsx`** — ag-grid v35 narrowed `GetContextMenuItems` return from `string` to the `DefaultMenuItem` literal union. Updated return type and added cast on the fallback branch:

```ts
// Before: (string | MenuItemDef)[]
// After:
const getContextMenuItems = useCallback((params: GetContextMenuItemsParams): (DefaultMenuItem | MenuItemDef)[] => {
  // ...
  items.push(item as DefaultMenuItem);
});
```

### Test errors

- **`ListViewGroupingPropagation.test.tsx`** — `vi.mock('@object-ui/core')` replaced the entire module, dropping `normalizeQuickFilters` which `ListView` now imports. Switched to `importOriginal` pattern to preserve real exports alongside the mocked `ExpressionEvaluator`.
